sources.entry: TRIP - Minimalist POI Map tracker and Trip planner. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Docker

summary.one_liner: TRIP is a self-hostable minimalist map tracker and trip planner for visualizing points of interest (POIs) and organizing multi-day trip itineraries.
summary.what_it_does: TRIP (Tourism and Recreational Interest Points) lets you map and manage points of interest on interactive maps. It also lets you plan multi-day trips with detailed itineraries. The README says it supports collaboration and sharing with travel companions. It is deployed with Docker, using either a provided docker-compose.yml or a docker run command that mounts a storage volume. Configuration docs cover OIDC authentication and other settings. The README states there is no telemetry, tracking, or ads. A live demo is linked.
use_cases: share trip plans with travel companions
track recreational places on a map
notable: Minimalist design focused on POI mapping and trip planning
No telemetry, tracking, or ads, per the README
Docker-first deployment with a ready docker-compose.yml
caveats: Configuration details are only referenced in external documentation, not in the README itself
Deployment is documented only for Docker; other install methods are not described
